note: Stage name tags: frame name -> object names (snake_case, typed as frame.object.method()). by_scene maps each stage scene id to its frame and each cut label to its object name. by_scene[id].time is the scene's in-story time HH:MM (24 h) shown as '#time: HH:MM' under a tapped name; time_src, tried in this order: card (the card/view caption in the run's job prompt), text (a clock time in the frame's own text), part (a time-of-day word in it, fixed mapping), tweet (the real tweet its caption line came from, id timestamp in Lagos WAT), medium_pub (publish time of the Medium post it was cut from, Lagos WAT), exif (original file EXIF), placeholder (stable FNV-1a hash of the scene id, 06:00-23:55, replaced once a real time exists); time_ref names the tweet id / post id; time_real false only for placeholders; time_story true for in-story clocks (card/text/part). Written by tools/export_frame_objects.py (cmd_loop).
